title: VersionSelection
description: Phase 6/7 director contract: the selection record that names which draft version was chosen for one chapter, and why. It is the auditable output of a VersionComparison. This is a DERIVED production artifact, not a registry fact (ADR-006). Two structural invariants: `gating` const false (ADR-003) — a selection NEVER blocks a build. `authority` const human (ADR-009) — choosing a version for INTERNAL production follows the Commercial Loop precedent; the outward transition (publish) stays a separate human decision, never triggered by this record.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): internal selection may be automatic; the outward publish transition stays human and is never triggered by this record.

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): a version selection NEVER blocks a build.
